title: Remember Better: - Create Your Own Notes: Instead of Copying, Rephrase in Your Own
description: To remember better: - Create your own notes: Instead of copying, rephrase in your own words. - Teach someone else: Explaining ideas reinforces your understanding. - Summarize: Generate key points from what you learn and write them down. Example: After a meeting, jot down what you’ve learned in your own words to solidify your memory.
